eyebrow.purpose: Short context above a title: section, audience, status, or category.

slide-title.purpose: A claim-led page title that advances the narrative.

dek.purpose: A one-sentence explanation immediately below a title.

lead.purpose: A larger narrative sentence that carries the main read without a container.

body.purpose: Explanatory prose, limited to compact readable blocks.

metric.purpose: A dominant number, ratio, amount, or short measurable outcome.

metric-context.purpose: Baseline, target, comparison, or interpretation paired with a metric.

step-index.purpose: A compact ordinal that establishes sequence without becoming a card badge.

step-label.purpose: A verb-led stage or milestone name paired with an ordinal or connector.

quote.purpose: A short attributed quotation or deliberate editorial statement.

attribution.purpose: Speaker, source, or evidence attribution paired with a quotation.

definition.purpose: A precise term plus a short definition, often using typographic contrast.

decision.purpose: The explicit recommendation or approval statement on a closing page.

question.purpose: A framing question used sparingly to create a narrative turn.

annotation.purpose: A concise label tied to a mark, connector, axis, or highlighted region.

caption.purpose: A short explanation directly attached to an image or visual.

table-header.purpose: A column or row header that establishes comparison grammar.

code.purpose: A short identifier, command, formula, or technical token.

source.purpose: Compact on-slide source or methodology credit in the footer zone.

footer.purpose: Page number, confidentiality marker, or recurring deck chrome.
